name: Beth-horon
line: Beth-horon was a pair of towns, Upper and Lower, on a steep road near Gibeon, where Israel won a great battle and where Solomon later built strong walls.

moments.title: Chased down the pass
moments.text: The LORD threw Israel's enemies into confusion at Gibeon. Israel chased them along the uphill road to Beth-horon and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.

moments.title: Hailstones from the sky
moments.text: As the enemy fled down from Beth-horon toward Azekah, the LORD cast large hailstones on them. More died from the hailstones than from the swords of Israel.

moments.title: Solomon builds up the towns
moments.text: Solomon rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as strong cities, built up for defense with walls, gates, and bars.
